name: system-architect
description: Assign product changes to owned modules, protect shared surfaces, and check file scope before integration.

interface.shortDescription: Route changes into owned modules and protect shared code.
interface.longDescription: For multi-agent codebases where feature work must stay inside one module. The plugin records file ownership, protects shared shells and APIs, defines versioned interfaces, and checks planned or actual Git changes before integration.
defaultPrompt: Place this change in one owned module and define its interfaces.
Check whether this diff crosses a registered module boundary.
Extract this feature from a frontend monolith without replacing the shell.
